Name: Blue Moon Craft
Author: WananGD
TagLine: 这是一个基于Stardew Valley Expanded 的拓展模组。增加了一个新的葡萄植株，同时你也可以使用蓝月亮农场的酿酒工艺获得更高的收益。 This is an expansion mod based on Stardew Valley Expanded. It adds a new grape plant, and you can also use Blue Moon Farm's winemaking craft to earn higher profits.
Description:
原版SVE中的蓝月亮葡萄酒获得的途径非常有限，使用场景也非常有限，此模组能使蓝月亮葡萄酒为你带来收益。
获得索菲娅6星好感后，你可以获得和购买蓝月亮农场特有的葡萄植株。在向索菲娅求婚后索菲娅将把蓝月亮农场中的酿酒工艺教授给你，你会获得一个特殊的桶能够用来酿造和陈化蓝月亮葡萄酒。
In the original SVE, the ways to obtain Blue Moon Wine are very limited, and its usage scenarios are equally restricted. This mod allows Blue Moon Wine to generate profits for you.
After reaching a 6-star affection level with Sophia, you can acquire and purchase the unique grape plants from Blue Moon Farm. Then, after proposing to Sophia, she will teach you the winemaking craft of Blue Moon Farm.After proposing to Sophia, she will teach you the winemaking techniques at Blue Moon Farm, and you will receive a special barrel that can be used to make and age Blue Moon wine.
这个模组还没有进行全面的测试和对收益的精细计算，游玩时遇到任何问题和建议请提交给我。
This module has not undergone comprehensive testing and precise calculation of revenue yet. Please submit any problems or suggestions you encounter while playing to me.

Downloads.Description:
1.增加了地窖（内部还不太好看，以后应该会优化）。可以在罗宾商店里建造，地窖里可以使用蓝月亮酒桶和原版的木桶。

A cellar has been added.

2.将蓝月亮葡萄园场景里的葡萄替换成了精灵葡萄。

The grapes in the Blue Moon vineyard scene have been replaced with Fairy grapes.

3.修改了信封细节和邮件字体颜色，降低封面对阅读的影响。

Optimized the mail.

4.部分文本优化
